name: workspace
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Workspace instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Workspace tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Workspace through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Workspace Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Workspace only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
